name: torrix
description: Logs every Claude Code model call (tokens, cache, cost, prompts, tool calls, subagents) to your self-hosted Torrix instance.

base_url.title: Torrix URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your Torrix instance.

api_key.title: Torrix API key
api_key.description: A trxk_ key from Torrix > API Keys. Stored in the OS secure store.

project.title: Torrix project
project.description: Optional project id or name. Leave empty for your default project.

agent_key.title: Agent credential (enforcement)
agent_key.description: Optional trxa_ credential with the authorize scope. Needed only when guard is observe or enforce.

guard.title: Tool enforcement
guard.description: off, observe or enforce. Default off.

guard_fail.title: When Torrix is unreachable
guard_fail.description: open allows the tool, closed denies it. Default open.
